proof-narrative-lean-equiv.evidence: Lean (lean/QOU/Observations/hecke_satisfies_blitvic_hypothesis.lean:151) derives odd vanishing from the assumed class [HeckeBlitvicWickRecursion]; the md asserts it unconditionally. The md claim is false (see da-false-claim), so the class is not satisfied by the real Markov-trace moments.

Re-read 2026-11-17. Lean hecke_satisfies_blitvic_hypothesis derives odd vanishing only from the assumed class HeckeBlitvicWickRecursion; the md asserts the decomposition unconditionally. The md claim is false: for one generator in H_2 under convention D, the third central moment is tr(s^3) - 3z tr(s^2) + 2z^3 = h^2 z + h - 2z - 3hz^2 + 2z^3, which at q = 2 (h = 3/2, z = 8/5) is -1.428, not 0. So the Wick class cannot be satisfied by the actual Markov-trace moments.

Re-read 2026-11-18 after rewrite. The md states tr((s-z)^3) != 0 at q=2, convention D, for the Markov trace; lean.ref markovTrace_centred_cube_ne_zero proves exactly that, with centred_cube giving the closed form for any trace with tr 1 = 1, tr s = z. Sorry-free.
